defects: Framing/gaze: Zoubida is framed tightly from the chest up in profile against a bare wall, leaving the cedar ceiling beams she is looking up at completely out of frame and her eyes wide open instead of squinting.
Props/scale: the flies floating around her are oversized (larger than her eye and earring) and read as crude, flat grey blobs with stiff wings.
tiles.fix: Tilt or widen the framing slightly to suggest the ceiling beams above, give Zoubida a squinted expression, and scale down and refine the flies.

defects: Pose/gesture: Zoubida holds a stiff, mannequin-like posture with both arms bent rigidly—her right hand raised flatly and her left hand hovering over her yellow sash with awkward, empty curled fingers.
Props/framing: oversized, uniform flies clutter the air directly in front of her face and raised hand, while the foreground glass lamp/bottle at bottom center awkwardly overlaps her hips.
tiles.fix: Relax Zoubida's shoulders and fingers into a natural, decisive gesture, reduce the fly scale, and shift the foreground lamp out of the center overlap.

defects: Right hand raised to shade her eyes sits too low across the bridge of Zoubida's nose and eyes, obscuring her eyes and peering gaze from the camera.
tiles.fix: Raise Zoubida's right hand slightly higher onto her forehead/brow so her squinting eyes remain clearly visible peering up toward the ceiling beams.

defects: Zoubida's head and gaze are turned down and to the left away from the window while her left arm holds the dish cloth up toward the window on the right, disconnecting her gaze from the action.
The dish cloth hangs limp instead of snapping/whipping, and all flies have completely disappeared rather than being visible exiting out the right window as the beat describes.
Right fingertips slightly clip into the folds of her yellow waist sash.
tiles.fix: Turn Zoubida's head and eyes toward the right window to follow the flies exiting, keep a cluster of flies swarming out through the window opening, and pull her right hand slightly outward to rest cleanly on the sash.

worst_problem: In the bedroom 3D-character shots (s03 12.0 and s03 20.5), Zoubida's stiff posing and oversized, crude fly assets weaken the staging against the otherwise rich painted plates. | In s03 53.1 Zoubida looks away to the left instead of toward the window she is waving the limp dish cloth at, and no flies are shown exiting the window.
